title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
title_zh: TASK Memory：通过 Activation Steering 与 Knowledge Editing 超越纯文本记忆，缓解记忆幻觉
abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on external memory, yet they still hallucinate about what they remember. Often the correct memory is retrieved and placed in the prompt, but the answer contradicts it or the memory is applied to the wrong question. We call these use-time memory hallucinations. Across five open models, we find that they arise from the conflict between parametric knowledge and external memory and take three forms: memory-ignoring, where the model returns to a stale fact in its weights (up to 46% of queries); memory-misapplying, where it attributes the memory to unrelated entities (up to 24%, and 49% when retrieval is combined with weight editing); and version confusion, where 53% of answers about revised facts assert the superseded value when both versions remain stored. We propose TASK memory, which goes beyond text-only memory by combining a Text note with Activation Steering and Knowledge editing that share one in-model address. The text holds the content. A removable knowledge edit supplies the address through its subject key and supports multi-hop composition. A pair of steering vectors decides, query by query, whether the model adopts the memory or keeps its own answer; the vectors store no content and control how the text memory is used. On frozen models under a pre-registered, test-once protocol, TASK reduces memory-ignoring hallucinations to at most 1.5% in all ten model-dataset cells and cuts neighbour misuse from 39.2% to 7.5% (+10.8 pp composite on CounterFact). It improves a 300-memory library over BM25 RAG by 16.4 pp, an advantage that holds at 3,000 memories, resolves fact revisions without fact IDs, and adds 7.5 pp of multi-hop accuracy on MQuAKE. 21 of 23 cross-model comparisons (8B-27B, four families) are significant, and TASK beats three recent context-steering methods in 9 of 10 model-dataset cells.
abstract_zh: 即使检索到了正确的外部记忆并将其放入提示，LLM 智能体仍可能给出与记忆矛盾的答案，或将记忆错用到无关问题上。作者将这类错误称为「使用时记忆幻觉」。对五个开放模型的分析表明，参数知识与外部记忆的冲突会导致三类错误：忽略记忆，沿用模型权重中的旧事实（最高占查询的 46%）；错用记忆，将事实归给无关实体（最高 24%，检索与权重编辑结合时达 49%）；版本混淆，新旧版本同时保留时，53% 的事实更新相关回答仍采用旧值。为此，作者提出 TASK Memory，让文本笔记、Activation Steering（激活引导）和 Knowledge Editing（知识编辑）共享同一个模型内部地址。文本保存事实内容，可移除的知识编辑通过主语键提供寻址并支持多跳组合，一对不存储事实内容的引导向量则按查询决定是采用外部记忆，还是保留模型自身的答案。在冻结模型、预注册且仅测试一次的协议下，TASK 将十个模型—数据集组合中的记忆忽略率均降至 1.5% 以下或等于 1.5%，将相近实体上的记忆错用率从 39.2% 降至 7.5%，并使 CounterFact 综合得分提升 10.8 个百分点。在包含 300 条记忆的记忆库上，TASK 比 BM25 RAG 高 16.4 个百分点，扩展至 3,000 条后仍有优势。它无需事实 ID 即可处理事实更新，并将 MQuAKE 的多跳准确率提高 7.5 个百分点。覆盖四个模型家族（8B–27B）的 23 项跨模型比较中，21 项达到统计显著；在十个模型—数据集组合中的九个，TASK 优于三种近期上下文引导方法。
key_points_zh: 论文区分了三类使用时记忆幻觉：忽略正确记忆、将记忆错用到无关实体，以及新旧事实并存时沿用旧版本。
TASK 将存储、寻址和采纳分开：文本存事实，Knowledge Editing 提供模型内地址，Activation Steering 按查询控制是否采纳。
十个模型—数据集组合的记忆忽略率均不超过 1.5%，相近实体上的记忆错用率由 39.2% 降至 7.5%。
在 300 条记忆下，TASK 比 BM25 RAG 高 16.4 个百分点，扩展至 3,000 条仍有优势；它无需事实 ID 即可处理更新，并使 MQuAKE 多跳准确率提高 7.5 个百分点。

agent-memory.reason: TASK 将部署中获得的事实保存为可修订的混合记忆，用同一模型内地址控制文本呈现、可卸载权重补丁和逐查询引导。摘录给出了写入、读取和修订的实现细节；跨模型对照、无门控引导对照及千条级记忆库测试支持其效果，并表明权重补丁主要有益于多跳组合，而非单事实问答。
agent-memory.quote: propose TASK memory, which combines text, activation steering and knowledge editing in one memory object
agent-memory.result_quote: neighbour misuse falls from 39.2% to 7.5% (Qwen3-8B, CounterFact).
